MODEL ILLUSTRATIONS — SOURCE AND ATTRIBUTION

All assets below are stored within SHYBOX documentation and referenced through
relative paths. No image download is needed to build or read the generated site.
Imported on 2026-11-12. Images are unchanged from the listed sources.

The source documentation identifies Fabio Delogu (2019) as its author;
the accompanying hmc-dev repository supplies the EUPL-1.2 licence.

Silvestro et al. (2013), DOI 10.5194/hess-17-39-2013.

The original figure caption credits the background to the ESRI Satellite theme
and identifies the Rutor glacier in northwestern Italy. That credit is retained
in the documentation caption; third-party imagery retains its original rights.
